title: Courseforge Promotion Chain Report
description: Master governance aggregator output (Worker W3.G). Walks all 9 arrows of the DART -> eval-report chain, reads each per-stage report best-effort, and produces a single canonical promotion-chain report. Per-arrow rows carry input/output hashes, the gate validator set that fired against the arrow, the W3.H source_coverage block, and a 4-value promotion_decision. Top-level chain_hash is a deterministic SHA-256 over the canonicalised arrow rows in chain order; course_status references the Wave 1 G2 5-value enum.

course_code.description: Operator-facing course code so cross-run diffs key cleanly.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call.

arrows.description: 9-arrow chain row array, ordered DART -> eval (arrow_id 1..9).

chain_hash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 over the canonicalised arrows[] payload (in chain order). Cross-run diff key for the chain.

course_status.description: 5-value Wave 1 G2 enum referencing schemas/governance/course_status.schema.json. Driven by lib.governance.course_status.derive_course_status.

evidence_quote_summary.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — corpus-wide evidence_quote rollup. Carries the unweighted-mean coverage_rate across arrows that surfaced an evidence_quote_metrics block. Optional for back-compat with legacy reports emitted before W-D11 T11.5.

input_hash.description: Upstream artifact hash. SHA-256 hex when known; null when the per-stage report didn't carry one.

output_hash.description: Downstream artifact hash. SHA-256 hex when known; null when the per-stage report didn't carry one.

validator_set.description: Gate IDs that fired against this arrow's emit. Anti-silent-degradation contract: when the per-stage report is missing, this MUST contain 'missing_stage_report' so an operator can see the silent-skip class.

passed.description: Whether all critical gates passed for this arrow. Null when the per-stage report is missing OR when the arrow is not gated.

warnings_count.description: Count of warning-severity gate failures attributed to this arrow.

source_coverage.description: Canonical W3.H source_coverage block when emitted by the per-stage report; null when the stage doesn't track coverage (e.g. arrow 8 / 9).

promotion_decision.description: Per-arrow verdict consumed by the course_status decision logic.

evidence_quote_metrics.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — optional per-arrow evidence_quote_* rate block. Stamped on arrows whose validator_set includes claim_support (block-side, Arrow 3) or pair_claim_support (pair-side, Arrow 7). Omitted on arrows whose seam doesn't run either gate. Optional for back-compat with legacy reports.

evidence_quote_coverage_rate.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — share of claims with a non-null evidence_quote that resolved against a cited chunk. Sourced from claim_support / pair_claim_support GateResult.metadata.

evidence_quote_substring_fail_rate.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — share of evidence_quote attempts that failed substring containment vs the cited chunk text.

evidence_quote_char_span_mismatch_rate.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — share of evidence_quote attempts whose evidence_char_span did not bracket the matched substring.

coverage_rate.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — unweighted mean of evidence_quote_coverage_rate across arrows that surfaced an evidence_quote_metrics block. 0.0 when no arrow exposed metrics.
